scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:findmedi: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:legacy: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:mind --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.dev.yml up -d --build backend frontend
scripts.docker:dev:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.dev.yml logs -f --tail 200 backend frontend
scripts.docker:dev:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.dev.yml stop backend frontend
scripts.docker:dev:install: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.dev.yml run --rm backend npm install && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.dev.yml run --rm frontend npm install
